title: Live Passionately. Connect Effortlessly.

location.series: Cox Brand Collection — Lindsay Little / Periscope

slide_intent: Connect a service promise to an ordinary human moment so the reader understands what reliability makes possible.
strategic_value: The family scene can position Cox as the unobtrusive support for a full household life.
demonstration: A translucent blue-to-teal vertical panel carries the promise and explanation over a bright kitchen scene.
practical_value: Choose a household activity that supports the promise, then keep the copy in a quiet part of the photograph.

content_islands.name: Message panel
content_islands.spec: Place a tall translucent gradient band on the left, with a large four-line headline and smaller explanatory paragraph.

content_islands.name: Family kitchen
content_islands.spec: Let the photograph fill the canvas behind the panel. Keep the adults and children interacting across the uncovered right side.

ingredient.name: Translucent gradient message panel
ingredient.role: Give the copy a distinct reading area while keeping the household scene visible.
ingredient.application: Place white headline and body text within the dark blue-to-teal band over the left side of the photograph.
ingredient.scope: Observed treatment in this retail positioning board. The source provides no universal opacity or color-proportion rule.
